newsitem.title: DENMARK: BG says Sell Danish bonds, buy mortgage-backed.
newsitem.headline: BG says Sell Danish bonds, buy mortgage-backed.

text.p: Denmark's BG Bank on Wednesday advised customers to sell government bonds against mortgage -backed paper, seeing the spread between the two narrowing.

"The yield gap between the (benchmark) eight percent, 2006 government bond and the mortgage-backed six percent bond due in 2026 has in recent weeks shrunk, albeit by a marginal two basis points to 116 bp," the bank --Denmark's third-largest said in its newsletter.
"BG Bank expects the gap to narrow further and therefore recommends the sale of the eight percent 2006 and the purchase of the mortgage-backed six percent 2026 or six percent 2029."
